RepoPress Studio 会在所选位置中新建一个“RepoPress D: RepoPress Studio will create a "RepoPress Data" folder in the selected location.
不能使用替身或符号链接作为数据文件夹。: Aliases and symbolic links cannot be used as the data folder.
之前保存的数据文件夹记录已损坏，请重新选择。: The saved data-folder record is damaged. Select the folder again.
之前的数据文件夹已被移动、删除或清空，请重新选择。: The previous data folder was moved, deleted, or emptied. Select it again.
包含草稿、历史版本、站点配置、资料库、RSS、附件和发布记录；默认不包含 API: Includes drafts, version history, site profiles, the library, RSS, attachments, and publishing records; API keys are excluded by default.
复制期间旧数据发生了变化，本次迁移已取消。请关闭其他 RepoPress Stu: The legacy data changed during copying, so migration was canceled. Close other RepoPress Studio windows and try again.
工作区数据和备份不包含 API Key。AI Key 按设置独立保存在受限本地配: Workspace data and backups do not contain API keys. AI keys are stored separately in a restricted local configuration file, System Keychain, or this session, as selected in Settings.
应用会先校验清单、快照、资料库、RSS 和附件；此步骤不会修改当前工作区。: The app first validates the manifest, snapshot, library, RSS, and attachments; this step does not modify the current workspace.
恢复会替换当前工作台、资料库、RSS 和应用内附件，并重新启动应用。当前数据会先: Restoring replaces the current workspace, library, RSS data, and managed attachments, then restarts the app. Current data is first preserved in a recovery folder for manual rollback.
所选位置包含多个数据文件夹，请打开其中一个并直接选择它。: The selected location contains multiple data folders. Open one and select it directly.
所选文件夹是空的。如果要使用它，请选择“新建数据文件夹”。: The selected folder is empty. To use it, choose "Create New Data Folder."
所选路径中的数据已变成另一个工作区。为避免打开错误数据，请手动重新选择。: The data at the saved path now belongs to a different workspace. Select it manually to avoid opening the wrong data.
所选项不是文件夹。: The selected item is not a folder.
数据文件夹无法校验：%@: The data folder could not be validated: %@
数据文件夹标记包含重复项。: The data-folder marker contains duplicate entries.
数据文件夹标记缺少应用版本。: The data-folder marker is missing the app version.
数据文件夹版本为 %d，当前应用仅支持 %d。请先升级 RepoPress St: The data folder is version %d, while this app supports version %d. Upgrade RepoPress Studio first.
数据文件夹的内容结构与标记不一致，未对原文件进行修改。: The data-folder contents do not match its marker. The original files were not modified.
数据文件夹缺少已声明的内容。: The data folder is missing a declared component.
数据根标记的类型不正确。: The data-root marker has an invalid type.
新数据文件夹未能完成初始化，未安装不完整的数据。: The new data folder could not be initialized. Incomplete data was not installed.
无法新建数据文件夹：%@: Could not create the data folder: %@
旧数据未能通过完整性校验，原文件保持不变。: The legacy data did not pass integrity validation. The original files remain unchanged.
未在本机找到可迁移的旧版工作台、资料库或 RSS 数据。: No legacy workspace, library, or RSS data was found on this Mac.
正在新建 RepoPress Studio 数据文件夹…: Creating the RepoPress Studio data folder…
目标位置已存在同名文件夹，请换一个位置。: A folder with that name already exists at the destination. Choose another location.
该文件夹不是有效的数据文件夹：它包含文件，但缺少数据根标记。: This is not a valid data folder: it contains files but has no data-root marker.
请先在主窗口完成数据文件夹设置。: Finish setting up the data folder in the main window first.
请恢复以前的数据文件夹，或新建一个工作区。: Restore your previous data folder or create a new workspace.
请选择包含 repopress-data-root.json 的数据文件夹。: Select the data folder containing repopress-data-root.json.
资料库、RSS、工作台和应用内附件会统一保存在这个文件夹。删除并重新安装应用后，: The library, RSS data, workspace, and managed attachments are stored together in this folder. After deleting and reinstalling the app, select it again to restore your data.
迁移本机旧版数据…: Migrate Legacy Data on This Mac…
这是旧版备份：恢复会替换当前工作台、资料库和应用内附件，但会保留现有 RSS 数: This is an older backup: restoring replaces the current workspace, library, and managed attachments but preserves existing RSS data. Current data is first kept in a recovery folder.
